targets.self_route_verdict: OVERTURNED IN PART -- and, per red-team F1, as a governance JUDGMENT rather than a forced reading of the claim text. The PASS is real and non-degenerate on C0 and C1: the baseline-relative floor gives the z_block integrator genuine dynamic range on a headroom DV, at an a-priori bar that provably rejects the un-calibrated predecessor regime. The label's second half ('clear_v3_pending') was put to the user at the Step 8 gate as a genuine two-reading choice, with MECH-353's release text quoted verbatim, and the user HELD v3_pending on 2026-09-05. The decisive reason is red-team F3, and it is prior to the num_hazards argument the draft led with: the assert-vs-withdraw dissociation MECH-353 names has NEVER been measurable anywhere in this family, because WITHDRAW IS UNREPRESENTABLE -- the driver runs at action_dim=4 while blocked_agency_noop_class defaults to 0, which CausalGridWorldV2 maps to MOVE-UP, and the stay action is index 4, unreachable by a 4-dim policy. So the claim's own named release run (the 642b lineage, which 642c supersedes and passes) has not yet been VALIDLY run, whatever its verdict. Recommended relabel: validated_substrate_calibration_v3_pending_stands.
targets.adjudication_flag_disposition: UPHELD AND BROADENED. The indexer flagged criteria_non_degenerate.C2=false, which the driver recorded honestly. This autopsy finds the degeneracy is a property of the ENVIRONMENT (num_hazards=0), not of C2: C3's third conjunct no_suffering (block z_harm_a_mean_policy <= control + 0.02) is 0.0 <= 0.0 + 0.02 on 3/3 seeds and is inert by the same construction, and was not flagged. Red-team F3 broadens it further and changes the count: C3's SURVIVING legs (no_withdraw / assert_sig) are not merely thin, they are MIS-SPECIFIED -- action_dim=4 with blocked_agency_noop_class=0 (= MOVE-UP) means action_rate scores 'fraction of steps not choosing move-up' and withdraw has no representation in the action space at all. So THREE OF THE FOUR load-bearing criteria carry an inert or mis-specified leg (C2 entire, C3's no_suffering, C3's assert_sig/no_withdraw), not two. The PASS does NOT rest wholly on a degenerate criterion -- C1 is live, non-degenerate and demonstrably discriminating -- but it rests on fewer independent legs than the criteria list implies, and C3 is UNINFORMATIVE about the assert-vs-withdraw contrast rather than weakly informative.

degenerate_criterion_legs: C2_dissociation_from_z_harm_a -- entire criterion: z_harm_a separation is 0.000 on 3/3 seeds (num_hazards=0), so (z_block_sep - z_harm_a_sep) >= 0.30 reduces to C1's first conjunct. Flagged by the driver (criteria_non_degenerate.C2=false, c2_degeneracy_reason).
C3_assert_not_withdraw, no_suffering leg -- block z_harm_a_mean_policy 0.0 vs control 0.0 on 3/3 seeds; the conjunct is trivially true and cannot vary. NOT flagged by the driver.

C3_assert_not_withdraw, assert_sig leg -- a zero-margin strict inequality (inherited from 642a and deliberately left alone per the 642b gate). Passing margins are 4/2400 steps (seed 42, action_rate 0.96208 vs 0.96042), 15/2400 (seed 43, 0.99667 vs 0.99042) and 24/2400 on the alt-switch route (seed 44, action_rate tied at 1.000, alt_switch 0.03792 vs 0.02792). Red-team H4: on seed 43 C3 passes ONLY via action_rate, while that seed's alt_switch goes the WRONG WAY (0.01625 block vs 0.02000 control, i.e. -9/2400) -- so the alt-switch signature the fan-out's drive probe expects to be ELEVATED is, on one of three seeds, depressed. Red-team F7 (pre-run) also records that C3's policy-arm rates are arm-order confounded (ARM_BLOCK always first; residue and hippocampal state are not reset between arms).

C3_assert_not_withdraw, no_withdraw + assert_sig legs -- MIS-SPECIFIED, not merely thin (red-team F3, and the decisive defect in this artifact). The driver runs at action_dim=4 (experiments/v3_exq_642a_blocked_agency_zblock_discriminative.py:252) while blocked_agency_noop_class defaults to 0 (ree_core/utils/config.py:5608 and :7676; the driver's CFG_KWARGS never overrides it), and CausalGridWorldV2.ACTIONS maps 0 -> (-1,0) = MOVE-UP with the stay action at index 4 (ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py:113-115), which a 4-dim policy can never emit. So action_rate = fraction of steps whose argmax is not MOVE-UP, and WITHDRAW (passivity) has NO representation in the action space. The consumer inherits the same miswire: ree_core/affect/blocked_agency.py:426 gives the ASSERT score-bias's passive_term to cls == noop_class, i.e. it treats MOVE-UP as the passive option and penalises it while favouring the other three moves. C3 is therefore UNINFORMATIVE about the assert-vs-withdraw contrast. This is an experiment-CONFIGURATION defect, not a substrate bug (the knob exists and is settable), and it is inherited unchanged across V3-EXQ-642 / 642a / 642b / 642c.

four_layer_diagnosis.environment: too sparse for the claim, adequate for the substrate question -- CausalGridWorldV2 size 8, toroidal, num_hazards=0, num_resources=0, block_interval 2 at prob 1.0. That configuration is exactly right for validating the floor calibration (the manipulation is scheduled action-blocking and nothing else varies). It is inadequate for MECH-353 for two reasons, and the SECOND is prior and decisive. (i) num_hazards=0 pins z_harm_a at 0.0 in both arms, so the dissociation partner cannot move and capacity_belief is pinned at 1.0 -- note the CORRECT cell for that is capacity_belief = 1 - capacity_collapse_weight * ||z_harm_a|| (ree_core/agent.py:4209-4214; the formula is named at agent.py:4022-4023), NOT motor_gate_shut_frac / motor_agency, which feed the ATTRIBUTION gate and are a different gate entirely (red-team H1; the draft cited the wrong cell for a true conclusion). (ii) Prior to any of that, the WITHDRAW POLE IS UNREPRESENTABLE in this action space: action_dim=4 with blocked_agency_noop_class=0 -> MOVE-UP, stay is index 4 and unreachable (red-team F3). So no capacity manipulation in this bed could have instantiated withdraw even if capacity HAD been challenged. This is an experiment-configuration defect inherited across the whole 642 family.
four_layer_diagnosis.measurement: partial / under-instrumented -- four findings. (a) THREE of four load-bearing criteria carry an inert or mis-specified leg (see degenerate_criterion_legs and criteria_non_degenerate_adjudicated). (b) The run recorded, in every arm, both the detector's own classification count (n_external_block_ticks) and the environment's ground-truth blocked-step count (n_blocked_steps), and nothing compared them (see detector_specificity_finding). (c) n_external_block_ticks (a driver-side run total) and n_external_blocks_counter (from blocked_agency.get_state()) sit side by side in the same per-arm dict and are not commensurable -- seed 44 ARM_BLOCK reads 1068 and 0 respectively. Precisely (red-team H3): blocked_agency.reset() zeroes _n_external_blocks (blocked_agency.py:456) and the loop calls agent.reset() on env-done, so the counter reports TICKS SINCE THE LAST env-done, which is not necessarily an episode boundary -- the observed block-arm values 34 / 56 / 0 are not 'final episode' totals of ~60. (d) Only COUNTS were recorded, never SERIES: no per-tick external_block or action_blocked flag list is kept or emitted (the run pack's metrics.json is 53 bytes), so the block-arm confusion matrix is not derivable from this run at any cost (red-team F5).

detector_specificity_finding.summary: RETITLED per red-team F2: BASELINE-RELATIVE MISMATCH-FLOOR FREE-STEP FALSE-POSITIVE RATE (6-15 pct of control-arm ticks). NEW and previously unrecorded, computed from cells the manifest already contains. The draft located this defect on the external-attribution gate; that is wrong. The ATTRIBUTION (motor) clause never discriminated in this run: motor_gate_shut_frac is 0.0 in BOTH arms on 3/3 seeds and motor_agency_min is 0.736-0.742 against attribution_motor_floor 0.5, so the clause was TRUE on all 14400 measured ticks -- it removed nothing, admitted nothing, and is INERT in this run. In ree_core/affect/blocked_agency.py:318-323 the predicate is (not baseline_seeded_this_tick AND goal_ok AND mism >= effective_floor AND motor >= attribution_motor_floor); with the goal pinned active and baseline seeding excluded, the ONLY clause that can be False on a control-arm tick is mism >= effective_floor. So every one of the 357 / 362 / 147 ARM_CONTROL fires is a FREE STEP whose outcome_mismatch crossed the 1.5x-EMA floor: ARM_CONTROL free_step_mismatch_mean 0.384 / 0.462 / 0.493 against effective_mismatch_floor_mean 0.701 / 0.775 / 0.893, i.e. the tail of the free-step mismatch distribution crosses the floor 6-15 pct of the time. That is the calibration THIS substrate_queue entry is itself about.
measured: seed 42: ARM_CONTROL n_blocked_steps 0 of 2400, n_external_block_ticks 357 (14.9 pct). ARM_BLOCK n_blocked_steps 1179 of 2400 (49.1 pct), n_external_block_ticks 867 (36.1 pct).
seed 43: ARM_CONTROL 0 of 2400 blocked, 362 detector fires (15.1 pct). ARM_BLOCK 1183 of 2400 blocked, 933 fires (38.9 pct).
seed 44: ARM_CONTROL 0 of 2400 blocked, 147 detector fires (6.1 pct). ARM_BLOCK 1180 of 2400 blocked, 1068 fires (44.5 pct).
detector_specificity_finding.derived_upper_bound_on_recall: ARM_BLOCK detector fires as a fraction of actually-blocked steps, an UPPER bound because some block-arm fires certainly land on free steps: 867/1179 = 73.5 pct, 933/1183 = 78.9 pct, 1068/1180 = 90.5 pct. If the control-arm false-positive rate transfers to the block arm's free steps (an ASSUMPTION, not a measurement), true-positive recall is nearer 58-84 pct.
detector_specificity_finding.why_it_matters: The aggregate BLOCK-vs-CONTROL mean separation survives this comfortably -- C1 is not undermined. What it does mean: any experiment or claim that reads z_block, or external_block_this_tick, as an indicator that an external block OCCURRED inherits a 6-15 pct base-rate contamination with no signal that it is there. It does NOT, however, support H2. The FP rate is evidence about the FLOOR, not about the attribution clause's permissiveness, which was never exercised at all (red-team F2c) -- the H2-support sentence the draft carried here is withdrawn. H1 vs H2 is untouched by this run.
detector_specificity_finding.provenance: Both COUNTS are recorded per arm per seed in per_seed[].ARM_BLOCK / ARM_CONTROL. This is analysis of recorded cells, not a new measurement and not a recording gap. Note the limit (red-team F5): only counts exist, never per-tick series, so the ARM_CONTROL rate is derivable ONLY because n_blocked_steps is 0 there (every fire is a false positive by construction). In ARM_BLOCK, 867 fires against 1179 blocked and 1221 free steps cannot be split into TP/FP at all; the 58-84 pct recall figure below rests on transferring the control FP rate, which is an ASSUMPTION, not a measurement.
detector_specificity_finding.relation_to_recorded_residual: This is the TICK-LEVEL FORM of the CONTROL-transient residual the entry ALREADY records, not a distinct new defect on the same file (red-team F2). Runs of consecutive free-step floor crossings are exactly what drives the CONTROL arm's z_block transiently to the 1.5 cap -- the residual recorded in the entry's severity_note ('CONTROL z_block_peak still reaches 1.500 on 3/3 seeds') and described by the driver (headroom_dv_diagnostics.note: 'this run does NOT close that entry'). failure_location.net_classification: PASS -- chargeability read, not a failure read. The result IS chargeable to the SUBSTRATE on the calibration question: Implementation completeness reads complete, C1 is non-degenerate, and the a-priori 0.30 bar demonstrably discriminates the un-calibrated regime (642a, 0.083-0.165, all below bar) from the calibrated one (0.590-0.771, all above), so the PASS is attributable to the built lever rather than to an implementation or measurement artefact. It is NOT chargeable as a MECH-353 CLAIM validation: Measurement adequacy reads partial (THREE of four criteria carry an inert or mis-specified leg -- red-team F3/H6 -- and the mismatch floor's free-step false-positive rate was recorded but never scored) and Environment adequacy reads too sparse (num_hazards=0 removes the dissociation partner and pins capacity_belief; and prior to that, the withdraw pole is unrepresentable at action_dim=4 with noop_class=0, so no capacity-collapse contrast was expressible in this bed at all). REE FAILED is not reachable, is not asserted, and would be the wrong frame in any case -- nothing failed.

biological_reference.closest_mechanism: Frustrative non-reward / Panksepp RAGE assert-pole: a comparator on expected-minus-obtained action outcome, firing without noxious input, driving assertion and effort escalation rather than withdrawal.
dependencies: a trained action-conditional forward model of the intended effect (SD-056 / SD-031)
a trained world encoder so the comparator has a non-degenerate target (SD-070)
a live goal / wanting expectation (MECH-112 z_goal)
an external-vs-self attribution channel (motor agency, SD-029 family applied to the action-outcome channel)
a retained capacity-belief gate, with hand-off to the suffering accumulator on collapse (SD-019b / Q-036)
biological_reference.divergence: None load-bearing. The detector is a single-pass comparator, which is the biologically-evidenced form (Carruthers 2012), not a two-pass counterfactual import -- this family does not repeat the SD-003 error. The divergence that IS live is scope, not mechanism: the biology defines FNR by the ABSENCE of noxious input, which makes the harm-free environment a faithful instantiation of the antecedent but an inadequate test of the dissociation-from-harm PREDICATE the claim registers as its falsifier.

targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: standard, not substrate_ceiling and not substrate_conditional. Nothing here asserts that MECH-353's answer is gated on substrate work -- the substrate is built and this run shows it works. What is owed is an EXPERIMENT in a richer environment, which is exactly the case the skill says maps to standard with the diagnosis in the note fields. Stamping substrate_ceiling or substrate_conditional would additionally make MECH-353 non-v3-testable (_claim_v3_testable) and starve it of experiment lanes at the moment the correct route is a new experiment lane.

targets.work_graph_note: The frame is well posed -- everyone agrees what a dissociation test looks like and the environment already supports hazards -- and a FACT is missing: does z_block dissociate from z_harm_a when z_harm_a is free to vary, and is the BLOCK-vs-CONTROL elevation attributable to the external-attribution gate rather than to generic outcome-mismatch? That is a puzzle (known rules), which routes to a spike, i.e. /queue-experiment a diagnostic. It is NOT complicated (buildable): the substrate is already built and a build would be the wrong instrument. It is NOT mystery (known data): the data that would settle it does not exist yet -- this run's environment could not produce it.

MECH-353.change: v3_pending STAYS TRUE -- by USER GATE DECISION on 2026-09-05, recorded as a governance JUDGMENT and NOT as a forced reading of the claim text (red-team F1). Both readings were put to the user with the claim quoted verbatim. Reading 1, the claim's own words: evidence_quality_note -- 'v3_pending=true until the smallest-V3 blocked-action discriminative experiment lands (env repeatedly blocks an intended predicted-to-succeed action, harm + goal held constant; measure assert-vs-withdraw dissociation from z_harm_a under matched controllability)'; implementation_note -- 'v3_pending remains TRUE until the post-build blocked-action discriminative validation, V3-EXQ-642b, passes'. Harm HELD CONSTANT is the claim's own instruction, the phrases 'free to vary' and 'num_hazards' appear nowhere in the claim, and 642c supersedes and PASSes the named 642b lineage -- so a fair reader could call this run the release. Reading 2, which the user took: the assert-vs-withdraw dissociation has NEVER been measurable anywhere in this family, because withdraw is UNREPRESENTABLE (action_dim=4 with blocked_agency_noop_class=0 = MOVE-UP; stay is action index 4 and unreachable), so the claim's named release run has not yet been VALIDLY run at all, whatever its verdict. Routing: V3-EXQ-642d with withdraw representable. What governance should apply regardless of that choice: rewrite evidence_quality_note per recommended_evidence_quality_note, refresh live_status.evidence.from to this artifact, set diagnostic_evidence_adjudicated true, and -- since MECH-353 currently carries NO epistemic_category field at all -- set one -> epistemic_category: standard
MECH-353.v3_pending_recommendation: STAYS TRUE -- user gate decision 2026-09-05, held as a governance judgment (see change). MECH-353 carries none of epistemic_category, pending_retest_after_substrate or diagnostic_evidence_adjudicated today (red-team H2), so the two recommended fields are ADDs, not sets-to-a-new-value; pending_retest_after_substrate is deliberately not recommended at all, since there is nothing waiting on a build to set it false about.
MECH-353.v3_pending_release_condition_restated: The claim's own release text, verbatim, is the starting point, and it does NOT name num_hazards: evidence_quality_note -- 'v3_pending=true until the smallest-V3 blocked-action discriminative experiment lands (env repeatedly blocks an intended predicted-to-succeed action, harm + goal held constant; measure assert-vs-withdraw dissociation from z_harm_a under matched controllability)'; implementation_note -- 'v3_pending remains TRUE until the post-build blocked-action discriminative validation, V3-EXQ-642b, passes'. 'Harm + goal HELD CONSTANT' is the claim's own instruction, so a hazard-free bed is not per se disqualifying, and the draft's earlier 'leg A requires z_harm_a to be free to vary' inverted the clause it quoted (red-team F1). The binding reason v3_pending is HELD is different and prior: the assert-vs-withdraw dissociation the clause names has never been MEASURABLE in this family, because withdraw has no representation in the action space (action_dim=4, blocked_agency_noop_class=0 -> MOVE-UP; stay is index 4, unreachable), so C3's action_rate scores 'fraction of steps not choosing move-up' and the consumer's ASSERT bias (blocked_agency.py:426) treats move-up as the passive option. The named release run has therefore not validly run. CLEAR v3_pending on a run in which WITHDRAW IS EXPRESSIBLE (action_dim=5 with blocked_agency_noop_class=4, or an explicit no-op arm) and the assert-vs-withdraw contrast is scored with a pre-registered non-zero margin and a counterbalanced arm order. A hazards-present arm additionally makes C2's subtraction and C3's no_suffering conjunct live for the first time in the family, and is what tests H3. V3-EXQ-642d is specified to carry both.

learning_extracted: A criterion degeneracy caused by a PINNED ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE is a property of the environment, not of the criterion -- so sweep every criterion leg that reads that variable, not the one that made the degeneracy obvious. V3-EXQ-642c correctly flagged criteria_non_degenerate.C2=false because num_hazards=0 makes the z_harm_a separation identically 0, and missed that the SAME pin makes C3's third conjunct (no_suffering: block z_harm_a_mean_policy <= control + eps, i.e. 0.0 <= 0.02) trivially true on every seed. The driver did perform exactly this sweep for the other degeneracy it fixed -- red-team F8 re-keyed C1/C2/C3 non-degeneracy off the clamp-pinned peak onto z_block_mean -- so the discipline exists in the file; it was applied to the pinned STATISTIC and not to the pinned VARIABLE.

Check a claim's v3_pending RELEASE CONDITION clause by clause against the validating run's environment CONFIG, before the run, not against its outcome afterwards. MECH-353's release condition reads 'measure assert-vs-withdraw dissociation from z_harm_a under matched controllability'; the validating environment pins num_hazards=0 (removing the dissociation partner) and never challenges capacity (motor_gate_shut_frac 0.0, motor_agency 0.74-0.78 in both arms, so only the assert pole is instantiated). A PASS on such a run can validate the substrate lever and still be structurally unable to release the claim -- and the run's own self-route label said clear_v3_pending.

Recording two series is not the same as scoring the relation between them. V3-EXQ-642c recorded, per arm per seed, both the detector's classification count (n_external_block_ticks) and the environment's ground-truth blocked-step count (n_blocked_steps), and nothing compared them. The comparison is the strongest unscored result in the manifest: the external-attribution gate fires on 6.1-15.1 pct of ticks in an arm with zero blocks. This is the mirror image of a recording gap -- the readout was recorded and the analysis was not specified.

Two same-named counters in one manifest dict can be measured over different windows. n_external_block_ticks is a driver-side run total; n_external_blocks_counter comes from blocked_agency.get_state(), and blocked_agency.reset() zeroes _n_external_blocks (blocked_agency.py:456) while the loop calls agent.reset() on env-done -- so it reports TICKS SINCE THE LAST env-done, which is not necessarily an episode boundary (red-team H3; the observed 34 / 56 / 0 are not 'final episode' totals of ~60). Seed 44 ARM_BLOCK reads 1068 and 0 side by side. Name the window in the key, or emit only one.

POSITIVE -- the template worth reusing. When a statistic change forces a threshold to be re-derived, the anti-fabrication-safe pattern is: (a) state an a-priori derivation rule in the DV's own units before looking at any observed separation (here, every margin = 20 pct of Z_BLOCK_CAP), (b) verify the rule lands somewhere useful by REPLAYING the criterion over the recorded per-seed cells of two predecessor manifests spanning the regimes you want discriminated (642a legacy floor -> C1 false 3/3; 642b calibrated floor -> C1 true 3/3), and (c) gate feasibility with a dv_headroom precondition so a starved criterion self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue instead of recording a falsification. This gave a bar that is stricter as a fraction of the DV's range than the one it replaced AND demonstrably discriminating, with zero threshold fitting. It is the direct answer to failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-642b learning 2.

A well-derived aggregate criterion can pass cleanly while the per-tick mechanism underneath it is noisy. C1's separation (0.59-0.77 against a 0.30 bar) is comfortable and real; the detector producing it has an estimated 58-84 pct recall and 85-94 pct specificity. Neither number contradicts the other, and only the first was scored. When a claim's distinctive content is an ATTRIBUTION (this mismatch was externally caused), the load-bearing readout is a confusion matrix, not a group-mean separation.

An experiment can be structurally unable to measure its own headline contrast, and no criterion-level repair will surface it -- check the ACTION SPACE against the behaviour the criterion names, at authoring time. V3-EXQ-642 / 642a / 642b / 642c all scored C3 'assert not withdraw' at action_dim=4 while blocked_agency_noop_class defaulted to 0, which CausalGridWorldV2 maps to MOVE-UP; the stay action is index 4 and a 4-dim policy can never emit it. So action_rate measured 'fraction of steps not choosing move-up' and WITHDRAW had no representation at all -- through four letters, a pre-run red-team, and three prior autopsies, none of which caught it. The consumer carried the same miswire (blocked_agency.py:426 gives the ASSERT bias's passive_term to move-up, penalising it and favouring the other three moves). This is the ACTION-SPACE sibling of learning 2's environment-CONFIG check: a criterion that names a behaviour must be checked against the space that behaviour would have to be expressed in, before the run.

Counts are not series, and 'we already recorded both numbers' is not 'the relation is derivable'. Learning 3 above says recording two series is not the same as scoring their relation; the sharper form (red-team F5) is that 642c recorded two COUNTS, never two SERIES, so the block-arm confusion matrix is not derivable at ANY compute cost -- only the control-arm false-positive rate is, and only because its ground-truth count is exactly zero. A reanalysis-is-free claim in a routing recommendation must be checked against what is actually on disk (here: a 53-byte metrics.json), not against what the driver appears to have measured.

decision.live_gate: Leg H3 resolved (z_harm_a free to vary and z_block separates from it) AND leg H1-vs-H2 resolved in favour of H1 (the external-attribution gate is load-bearing) AND the assert-vs-withdraw pole contrast instantiated.
decision.distance_phrase: One correctly-configured re-run away for H1/H2/H3 -- V3-EXQ-642d, carrying a hazards arm, a self-attributable-cancellation arm and a per-tick series. The H1-vs-H2 half is NOT free reanalysis: 642c recorded counts, not series, so no confusion matrix is derivable from it, and a confusion matrix alone would not separate H1 from H2 anyway. The claim's own decision question is a further design away (the capacity-collapse contrast), and that one is DEFERRED behind 642d.
decision.observation_bottleneck: TWO bottlenecks, and the second is prior and decisive. (i) The validating environment pins num_hazards=0, so the dissociation partner cannot vary and z_harm_a separation is identically 0.000. (ii) WITHDRAW IS UNREPRESENTABLE in the family's action space: every 642-family driver runs at action_dim=4 while blocked_agency_noop_class defaults to 0, which CausalGridWorldV2 maps to MOVE-UP, with the stay action at index 4 and unreachable -- so C3's action_rate has always scored 'fraction of steps not choosing move-up' and the consumer's ASSERT score-bias (blocked_agency.py:426) treats move-up as the passive option. The family's C3 has therefore NEVER measured the assert-vs-withdraw contrast, across 642 / 642a / 642b / 642c. This is recorded here as a CONFIGURATION FACT about the observation bed, deliberately NOT as a hypothesis leg: it was discovered by the Step 7c red-team from the driver source, not by the run's data, and it is not a rival explanation of anything -- adding it as a leg would inflate initial_frozen_count with a non-hypothesis. It is the reason MECH-353's v3_pending was HELD at the 2026-09-05 gate and the reason V3-EXQ-642d's action-space repair is its first spec item.

hypotheses.label: The baseline-relative outcome_mismatch floor gives z_block real dynamic range on a headroom statistic
hypotheses.desc: The V3-EXQ-642a defect was that a fixed absolute mismatch floor sat below the free-step baseline, pinning z_block at its cap in every condition. H0: the baseline-relative floor (ree-v3 d49db86f3e64670) fixes this, and a headroom DV (z_block_mean) separates BLOCK from CONTROL where the clamped peak cannot.

resolution.basis: C0 (the absolute readiness criterion) passed 3/3 at margins 0.601/0.547/0.498 vs floor 0.10, and C1 -- non-degenerate on the statistic it consumes -- passed 3/3 with separations 0.6805/0.5904/0.7709 against an a-priori 0.30 bar that rejects the un-calibrated 642a regime 3/3 (0.1650/0.1214/0.0831). confirmed, not eliminated: this establishes a necessary instrument, it does not close the question.

hypotheses.label: The separation is produced by the external-attribution gate selecting externally-cancelled steps
hypotheses.desc: The BLOCK-vs-CONTROL z_block_mean separation reflects MECH-353's claimed distinctive computation: mismatch attributed to an EXTERNAL constraint rather than to the agent's own motor error.
hypotheses.basis: Still live, and UNTOUCHED by V3-EXQ-642c. That run cannot separate H1 from H2 (its own pre-run red-team F2 concedes the design cannot distinguish an external block from a move cancelled by any means). Its control-arm firing rate of 6.1-15.1 pct is NOT evidence about this leg: the attribution (motor) clause was true on all 14400 measured ticks and never discriminated, so the false positives are mismatch-FLOOR crossings, not permissive attribution (Step 7c red-team F2). Adjudicated only by a self-attributable-cancellation arm, which is the only design that pushes motor_agency below the 0.5 attribution floor.
adjudicating_runs: V3-EXQ-642d (proposed) -- the SELF-ATTRIBUTABLE-cancellation arm specifically, not the main hazards contrast and not the confusion matrix alone

hypotheses.label: The separation is generic outcome-mismatch elevation; the external-attribution gate is not load-bearing
hypotheses.desc: Any sufficiently large action-outcome mismatch drives z_block, so a self-attributable cancellation (motor noise, execution failure) would produce the same elevation, and z_block is a relabelled surprise signal rather than a distinct attributional stream.
hypotheses.basis: Still live, and NOT supported by V3-EXQ-642c's control-arm false-positive rate -- that draft claim is withdrawn on Step 7c red-team F2c, since the FP rate is evidence about the mismatch floor and the attribution clause was never exercised. Discriminated from H1 only by a third, self-attributable-cancellation arm; the per-tick confusion matrix is a supporting readout and is not itself a discriminator (both hypotheses predict the same matrix in a design with no self-attributable cancellations).

hypotheses.label: With z_harm_a free to vary, z_block co-varies with it rather than dissociating
hypotheses.desc: MECH-353's registered distinctness predicate fails: under a block manipulation in a hazard-bearing environment, z_block and z_harm_a move together, so the blocked-agency stream is not separable from the harm stream and the claim is falsified on its own terms.
hypotheses.basis: Wholly untested. Every 642-family run to date pins num_hazards=0, so the measured z_harm_a separation is identically 0.000 and the dissociation criterion is algebraically inert -- the space has never contained an observation bearing on this leg.
